summary: Stellantis N.V. furnished a Form 6-K containing its Q2 2026 press release. The filing reports routine quarterly financial results: net revenues of €43.5 billion (up 13% YoY), net profit of €0.3 billion, adjusted operating income of €0.8 billion (1.8% margin), and industrial free cash flow of €1.0 billion. Management reaffirmed 2026 financial guidance and referenced the FaSTLAne 2030 strategic plan introduced at the May 21 Investor Day. No special-situation event occurs; this is an ordinary earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
